rationale: Both independently and correctly find the two most consequential regressions (ungated video_reference source_path breaking generic models; T2VA aspect_ratio check ordering breaking explicit-canvas requests), both well-grounded with concrete line evidence. X additionally lands a dedicated, well-argued finding matching the ground truth's repeated 'api server should not add model-specific code' theme (two separate reviewer comments) and presents fixes in a cleanly actionable blocker/should-fix/minor structure with explicit Fix: guidance. Y matches a subtler ground-truth nuance (tests using a fake engine mask the regression) almost verbatim and catches a genuine test-count inconsistency, but its dense audit-log format is somewhat less actionable and its unique-theme recall is narrower than X's.
